meta.name: integrate
meta.description: Build or change a customer-system integration with explicit data mapping, permissions, retries and reconciliation. Use for connectors, imports, write-back and upstream APIs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把客户或第三方系统的数据接进你的系统,管好字段映射、权限、重试与对账
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要把外部系统的数据接入或写回自己的系统。
copy.tagline_en: Connect an external system with mapping, permissions, retries and reconciliation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect a customer or partner system and keep data in sync.

howto.what: 帮你搭建或修改与客户系统的集成:写清数据映射、权限、重试与对账。它先读任务上下文与方法参考,再动手;不会声称装上技能就等于部署好基础设施。
howto.when: 当你要求构建或修改客户系统集成,如连接器、导入、回写等,或对接上游 API 时触发。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其脱敏数据包和范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 帮我设计一个从客户 CRM 导入联系人的集成,明确数据映射和权限。
say.note: Claude 会先读任务上下文和方法参考再动手。

say.text: 给这个回写接口加上重试和对账逻辑。
say.note: 在已有集成上补充重试与对账。

say.text: 检查这个连接器的权限和重试设置,列出没跑过的验证项。
say.note: 会如实报告未执行或缺失的能力。

howto.what_en: Builds or changes customer-system integrations with explicit data mapping, permissions, retries and reconciliation. It reads task context and method references first; it won't claim installing a skill provisions infrastructure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or change a customer-system integration (connectors, imports, write-back) or work with upstream APIs. Called by @fde, it reuses that packet.

say_en.text: Design a contact import from our CRM with explicit data mapping.
say_en.note: Claude reads task context and method first.

Review the permissions and retries on this connector.
